# Napnix — Full Reference

> Napnix is an India-based software development company building custom web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure and AI/ML solutions. It publishes two products: NapCRM, an industry-specific CRM platform from $49/month (₹4,165), and NapMail, an email marketing engine with SMTP rotation and anti-spam scoring.

All prices below are generated from the same source as the pricing pages and the Offer structured data, so they cannot disagree with them. Generated 2026-10-05.

## Company Facts

- Legal/brand name: Napnix (also searched as Napix)
- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: 2519 Azad Nagar, Balongi, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar (Mohali), Punjab 160055, India
- Email: info@napnix.in · Phone: +91 6239396615
- Core stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter, React Native, AWS

## NapCRM

NapCRM is a multi-tenant, industry-specific CRM platform. Each tenant gets isolated data, configurable modules and industry-specific workflows, covering lead management, customer records, e-commerce, invoicing, automation and multi-channel communication.

### NapCRM Pricing

| Plan | Monthly (USD) | Monthly (INR) | Yearly (INR, per month) | Leads | Customers | Products | Team members | Storage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $49 | ₹4,165 | ₹3,570 | 500 | 200 | 50 | 2 | 1 GB |
| Growth | $79 | ₹6,715 | ₹5,695 | 2,000 | 1,000 | 500 | 5 | 5 GB |
| Business | $99 | ₹8,415 | ₹7,140 | 10,000 | 5,000 | 2,000 | 15 | 25 GB |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Custom |

Pricing page: https://napnix.in/napcrm/pricing

### NapCRM Industry Editions

NapCRM ships 14 industry editions: Small Business, E-commerce, Real Estate, Service Businesses, Education, Healthcare, Hospitality, Travel, Fitness, Legal, Manufacturing, Logistics, Restaurants, Salons & Spas.

## NapMail

NapMail is an email marketing platform built for deliverability. It uses smart SMTP rotation, anti-spam scoring, and per-domain throttling to improve inbox placement, and integrates with NapCRM.

### NapMail Pricing

| Plan | Monthly (USD) | Monthly (INR) | Yearly (INR, per month) | Contacts | Emails/month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | ₹0 | ₹0 | 1,000 | 5,000 |
| Growth | $8 | ₹699 | ₹594 | 5,000 | 25,000 |
| Pro | $24 | ₹1,999 | ₹1,699 | 25,000 | 100,000 |
| Business | $59 | ₹4,999 | ₹4,249 | 100,000 | 500,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | Unlimited |

Product page: https://napnix.in/napmail
